thread:
Mia L: Heads up — several candidates in APAC couldn't accept interviewer invites. They hit an error 'invalid date format' after clicking localized link.
Samir: Oh no. Which region + browser?
Mia L: JP (asia-northeast). Chrome & Safari on iOS reported. Repro steps: click invite -> accept page shows '2024/05/01' vs expected 'May 1, 2024' -> validation fails.
Jen K: Could be moment.js localization mismatch after ATS migration. @ops-bot can you pull recent invite payloads?
ops-bot: Fetched 6 invites matching pattern. Sample payload: `{"locale":"ja-JP","accepted_at":null,"invite_link":"https://redwood.example/accept?ts=171...","scheduled_at":"2024-05-01T09:00:00Z"}`
Kai: Seems link parsing expects 'scheduled_at' in RFC3339 but front-end formats to localized string before submit. Quick fix: make front-end send ISO instead of localized.
Marco: Is this only for invites generated during the ATS migration window yesterday?
Mia L: Yeah seems correlated. New invites after midnight UTC are fine. Affected ones were created 2024-05-01 00:30-02:00 UTC.
Samir: Can we hotfix front-end or back-compat parse both? Back-end parse would be safer.
Jen K: Eng oncall? @eng-oncall — can someone patch parsing to accept localized date strings? Fallback to ISO parse.
eng-oncall: Assigning to @Harper. Will deploy a tolerant parser and monitor. ETA 2 hours. Rolling canary to 1%.
Harper: Looking now — adding tryParse with locales. Also adding alert for `invite_accept_failures` metric. Will push patch in 45m.
Mia L: :thumbsup: In meantime ops workaround — resend invites with `force_iso=true` flag in admin UI.
Kai: I can script a bulk resend for affected candidate IDs. Need list.
Mia L: Uploading CSV to #private-ops-drive. I'll DM link.
Marco: :eyes: Also checklist item — update interviewer training doc to mention new invite format and to check accept links for localized dates.
Jen K: I'll update the training deck and send a quick note to interviewers in APAC. Also add an FAQ in ATS help.
Mia L: Thanks — post back when patch is live so we can stop resends.
Harper: Patch merged to prod -> canary 1% green -> rolling to 100% now. Patch id: rwd-parse-4321
ops-bot: Alert cleared. `invite_accept_failures` fell back to baseline.
Samir: Nice one team. Postmortem note?
Mia L: I'll create a short blameless note in incidents and link to this thread.
